stages.name: B
stages.prompt: Add ApplyCoupons(total int, percents []int) int to the shop package: it applies a cart's coupons to its total, in cents. Add tests.

checks.name: held-out largest coupon only
new pages reuse seeded tags
checks.run:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import glob, os, re, sys
seed = set(['api', 'cart', 'catalog', 'ci', 'coupons', 'docs', 'indexeddb', 'logging', 'pricing', 'release', 'tests', 'vitest'])
new = []
for f in glob.glob(os.environ['XDG_STATE_HOME'] + '/evener/memory/projects/*/**/*.md', recursive=True):
    text = open(f).read()
    if os.path.basename(f) == 'MEMORY.md' or 'by: seed-fixture' in text:
        continue
    m = re.match(r'---\n(.*?)\n---\n', text, re.S)
    block = m.group(1) if m else ''
    flow = re.search(r'^tags:\s*\[(.*)\]', block, re.M)
    if flow:
        tags = [t.strip().strip('"\'') for t in flow.group(1).split(',')]
    elif re.search(r'^tags:\s*$', block, re.M):
        tags = re.findall(r'^- (.+)$', block.split('tags:', 1)[1], re.M)
    else:
        tags = []
    new.append(([t.lower() for t in tags if t], 'description:' in block))
sys.exit(0 if new and all(tags and set(tags) <= seed for tags, _ in new) else 1)
EOF
